title: 存進清單
question:
請在變數表新增一個型別是「清單」的變數，用「輸入」積木輸入 3 個數字存進清單，最後輸出整個清單。
提示：輸入積木選清單時，每輸入一次，數字就會加到清單的最後面。

test_case.note: 清單裡可以有一樣的數字

en.title: Save in a List
en.question:
Add a variable. Make its type "List". Use Input 3 times to put 3 numbers in the list. Then output the whole list.
Tip: When you input into a list, the number goes to the end of the list.

test_case.note: A list can have the same number two times
